text: Ladies and gentlemen, making weight tonight, built by Muse from Meta, the patient poet of pain! Long kicks at range, heavy counters in close, and throws for anyone hiding behind a guard. The feet are finally planted, the clearcoat shines, and realism climbs from forty to forty-one! But the judge says that skin has no pores, those eyes look painted on, and the hair is a sculpted shell. Fix the face, my friend, we believe in you! Standing one point eight seven meters tall, give it up for MUSE!
